fusions.name: Odometer Kick
fusions.desc: A piston-driven kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Stamping Mill
fusions.desc: Drives a geared iron boot into the ground, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Folded Mile
fusions.desc: A geared stride shortens the road and steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Pedometer Ratchet
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover clicks a ratchet that restores 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
